title: 59 Years Later, Anime Still Can’t Top This Legendary Masterpiece
content: Anime and manga series have been coming out for almost a century now, and with modern technology, newer anime and manga are appearing much more attractive. However, what they can’t beat is a compelling and timeless narrative.
author: ComicBook

title: The Margrave's Daughter & the Enemy Prince Manga Ends, Gets Side Story
content: Cygames ' Cycomi platform published the final chapter of An Ogura 's The Margrave's Daughter and the Enemy Prince manga on July 11. Ogura also announced a side story for the series focused on the character Iris.
author: ANN

title: Attack on Titan Quietly Delays Its Major U.S. Release
content: Written and illustrated by Hajime Isayama, the Attack on Titan manga began serialization in Kodansha’s Bessatsu Shonen Magazine in 2009. Four years later, in 2013, WIT Studio released an anime adaptation that became a massive hit worldwide.
author: ComicBook

title: Mobile Suit Gundam: A Real-Life Mech Is Preparing to Say Goodbye (And You Can Bid It Farewell)
content: As many Gundam fans know, Legendary Pictures and Bandai Namco Filmworks are teaming up to create a live-action movie that will present the Universal Century Arc in a brand-new way.
author: ComicBook

title: Shuu Katayama's Fujōri Zakkaten Unreal Manga Ends
content: The official X/Twitter account for Shinshokan 's Wings magazine announced on Monday that it will publish the final chapter of Shuu Katayama 's Fujōri Zakkaten Unreal (Absurd Variety Shop Unreal) manga in this year's October issue on Friday. The manga's fifth compiled book volume will ship in late November.
author: ANN

title: Junket Bank TV Anime Premieres on October 5
content: The official website for the television anime of Ikkō Tanaka 's Junket Bank manga announced on Thursday that the anime will premiere on TV Tokyo on October 5 at 12:00 a.m. JST (effectively, October 6). The series will air every Monday.
author: ANN

title: Fatal Fury City of the Wolves Game's New Animated Trailer by Masami Ōbari Highlights Duck King
content: SNK began streaming an animated trailer for the Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves fighting game to highlight the DLC character Duck King, who launched on Thursday, as well as the previous DLC fighter Rick Strowd.
author: ANN

title: We Are Aliens Film's Trailer Highlights Heisei Era
content: NOTHING NEW began streaming a trailer on Thursday for Kōhei Kadowaki and its We Are Aliens ( Ware Ware wa Uchūjin ) anime film , highlighting the Heisei era, the time period when the main characters meet.
author: ANN
